summary.text: Chamber Pot is Xiao Ye Hu's dark path Immortal Gu House. Fang clan hears it as a pocket-sized house that can forcefully absorb Gu Immortals.

claims.text: When Wan clan gathers an expedition against Fang clan, Xiao clan is named among the allies and is called the strongest support, sending Xiao Ye Hu. Fang clan immortals recount that he obtained a Gu Immortal true inheritance and a damaged Immortal Gu House when young, relied on it to become a Gu Immortal, received Xiao clan ‘s help to repair the house, and then changed his name to Xiao Ye Hu. They also pass on rumors that Chamber Pot is extremely strange and vicious, and that a Gu Immortal who cannot escape and stays trapped in the pot for a night becomes a pile of piss and stool.
Deviation (recorded): this page is filed under gu-houses because Chamber Pot is a named Immortal Gu House. It is mobile equipment tied to Xiao Ye Hu and Xiao clan, not a five-region map seat.

During the anti-Fang alliance battle, Xiao Ye Hu aims Chamber Pot at Earth Shuttle from afar and releases a pitch-black lump of light. Fallen Flower Hall slows that lump with fleeting bloom, and Earth Shuttle evades it.

Chamber Pot is pocket-sized, cannot carry people like normal Immortal Gu Houses, and suffers huge damage if used to rampage; its specialty is dealing with Gu Immortals. After Fang Gong leaves Inquiry Dock and wrecks Red River Wheel in open combat, Xiao Ye Hu finally shoots a pitch-black light lump at him. The lump strikes, but Fang Gong crushes it with his arms and then pursues Xiao Ye Hu.

When Fang Gong closes in and punches, Xiao Ye Hu moves Chamber Pot in front to block; the house is destroyed in the explosion, and the punch still drives Xiao Ye Hu to the verge of death. Fang Gong is judged not restricted by Chamber Pot, and the destroyed house is counted with Winding Light Platform and Red River Wheel as rank seven Immortal Gu Houses that can match rank eight battle strength.
